summary: RptMnuPositionUtilizationSummary is a web user control used to drive a position utilization summary report in the HSPnet system. It provides dropdowns for agency, department, and program selection, date range fields, and generates a position utilization summary report, displaying the results in HTML and optionally exporting to Excel. The control handles dynamic population of dropdowns based on user selection, manages validation, and executes a database procedure to retrieve the report data.
purpose: To allow users (typically staff) to generate and view a summary report of position utilization filtered by agency, department, program, and date range. The report output can be displayed as HTML or exported to Excel.

workflows.name: Generate Position Utilization Summary Report
steps: User loads the report menu control.
Control retrieves and displays description and options for the report.
Department dropdown is populated based on selected agency.
Program dropdown is populated based on selected department.
User selects values for agency, department, program, and date range.
Date field JavaScript variables are set for client-side scripting.
Database procedure 'ReportPosUtilSummary' is executed with parameters (SessionID, DepartmentID, ProgramID, DateFrom, DateTo).
Results are rendered as HTML or CSV.
HTML report is shown in a designated panel; Excel export is provided.

business_rules: Only valid date ranges can be entered.
Dropdowns dynamically filter options based on preceding selections (agency -> department -> program).
All required fields must be validated before generating the report.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator and CustomValidator for date fields
calculations: None in user control; report calculations are handled by the stored procedure 'ReportPosUtilSummary' and output formatting by ReportMain.OutputCSV.
conditions: If user changes agency, department dropdown is refreshed.
If user changes department, program dropdown is refreshed.
If dropdowns are empty, populate from database.
If reportHTML is not empty, display results panel.
system_behavior: Dropdowns are populated from database based on user session and selections.
JavaScript variables are dynamically set for client-side interaction.
HTML report panel is only visible if report content exists.
Excel export triggers stored procedure and generates downloadable output.
exceptions: If required fields (dates, dropdowns) are missing or invalid, validation errors are displayed and report generation is halted.
content_gaps: No explicit end-to-end business process description; information is inferred from control logic.
No details on contents or logic of the stored procedure 'ReportPosUtilSummary'.
No information on security, user permissions, or error handling beyond field validation.
